notes.subject: ⟨ye⟩
notes.rationale: Bamanankan bɛ copula wajibi kumasen kɔnɔ; Heburukan ma a sɔrɔ

notes.subject: tanin
notes.rationale: תנין: kɔgɔji-kɛnɛ masala ('sea-monster') walima sa bon — tɔgɔ bɛ to Heburu fɔcogo la

notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: Ayuw bɛ Yawe wele a tigɛli kɔnɔ, sɔrɔko min bɛ a kɔlɔsi i n'a fɔ bagan ye

notes.subject: kɔgɔji / tanin
notes.rationale: Kumasen in bɛ Ayuw ka kɔrɔfɔli jira: yala ne ye fɛn minnu bɛ se ka mara ye — kɔgɔji walima tanin — min de wajibi ka mara?

translation: Ne ⟨ye⟩ kɔgɔji ye, walima tanin, sabu i bila kɔlɔsibaga ne kan?
